ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Ice
ModMetaData.author: CheaterEater
ModMetaData.description:
Harvest ice from frozen lakes and use ice blocks to cool your base.
Pawns can designate Ice Harvest Zones over thin ice. Harvesting a cell removes the ice (which can refreeze naturally) and yields ice blocks. Ice blocks absorb heat as they melt, cooling the room they are stored in — a low-tech alternative to electric coolers.
Requires the Odyssey DLC for thin ice terrain. The mod loads safely without Odyssey but will have no effect.
